title: Carousel #01 — Accent Myth
description: Flagship trust-builder for @celpipspeaking. Flips the biggest anxiety in the CELPIP audience ("will my accent hurt my score?") and introduces the 5-dimension speaking rubric as the real scoring lens. 10 slides, 4:5 portrait. No product pitch.
palette: Near-black background, white text, vivid blue accent. Grainy gradient bloom in the corner (pearl-to-gold). Blue is the single accent color for the highlight block, underline scribble, save cue, side rule, and accent word.
